name: dsh-electron
description: DeepSeek Harness desktop shell: runs the dsh web app as a child process and loads it in an Electron window.

scripts.dist:standalone: pnpm run bundle && pnpm run standalone
scripts.dist:dir: pnpm run dist:standalone && pnpm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run dist:mac:x64 && pnpm run dist:mac:arm64
scripts.dist:mac:x64: pnpm run bundle && pnpm run standalone --arch x64 && pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: pnpm run bundle && pnpm run standalone --arch arm64 && pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run dist:standalone && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run dist:standalone && pnpm run build && electron-builder --linux
